board: CJMCU-3001 OPT3001 ambient light sensor module (purple, 6-pin: VCC, GND, SCL, SDA, INT, ADD)
reason: Check PASS on esp32 and pico (spec, wiring, design checks, breadboard, simulator, circuit board, footprint, LCSC). Result register 0x00 is modelled bit-exact per datasheet eq. 3 (lux = 0.01 x 2^E x R) with the chip in manual range RN=8 (E=8, 2.56 lx/count, 0-10483.2 lx), which the example configures; IDs 0x5449/0x3001 and reset values of config/limit registers are set. The driver supports auto range, single-shot and continuous modes per SBOS681C; the sim cannot follow auto-ranging, so it always reports exponent 8 (documented).
